derivation: For fixed target y, (1-g)*p0(y)+g*p1(y) is affine in g. Its maximum on[0,1] is max(p0(y),p1(y)). Taking logs and summing gives the per-document tokenwise hindsight bound.
limits: Already-inspected V30 TRAIN panel and fixed checkpoint/greedy notes; not fresh confirmation or a revised V30 endpoint.
Every token choice sees the actual target. A positive bound cannot show that a causal gate can recognize helpful predictions.
Only one original greedy note per document. No best-of-eight, candidate reselection, coefficient fit, model call or learning.
Does not measure ordinary-prefix opportunity/retention or natural corpus prevalence, serving latency, internalization or CPT benefit.
